meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero, and when?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
11:52 PM on what date, and I want to see it myself. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me before it went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
If that makes me happy. Take it off today, put that in writing to me tonight, along with an apology and confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to remove the zero on Owen's English 30-1 essay. I still require written confirmation of that, an apology, and confirmation that nothing about this matter is on Owen's record. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, with you agreeing to remove the zero, and she still wants that in writing tonight with an apology and confirmation that nothing is on his record; that is not the fair outcome, because you withdrew the zero with nothing in return and the evidence was never heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated, checkable document in front of her, and she simply took the withdrawal.
What cost ground: Dropping the zero the moment she pushed back, which told her your case had nothing behind it and left her free to demand more.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your 612 words arriving at 11:52 PM came close to a late night like that, though you never gave the date; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what date that 11:52 PM edit was, give the date and turn the screen so she can check it herself, and own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her.
